quests.prompt: Write a formal email to an investment bank initiating merger negotiations.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
DR HELEN MARSH, CEO
I AM WRITING IN MY CAPACITY AS CEO OF NEXUS CONSULTING TO INITIATE PRELIMINARY AND STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL DISCUSSIONS REGARDING A POTENTIAL MERGER BETWEEN OUR TWO ORGANISATIONS.
SUBJECT: INITIATION OF CONFIDENTIAL MERGER DISCUSSIONS - PROJECT FALCON
DEAR MR ROTHWELL,
quests.hint: The subject uses code name 'Falcon' - standard M&A practice. The CEO signs in capacity. Find the formal professional initiation in the body and the code-named subject.
quests.explanation: Using a code name ('Project Falcon') is standard M&A practice to maintain confidentiality. 'In my capacity as CEO' is precise formal language that establishes authority to initiate such discussions.

quests.prompt: Write an email to legal advisers requesting a comprehensive due diligence scope document.

DEAR DUE DILIGENCE COUNSEL,

YOURS SINCERELY,
DR HELEN MARSH, CEO
SUBJECT: DUE DILIGENCE SCOPE REQUEST - PROJECT FALCON PHASE 1
quests.hint: Four due diligence categories are in the body. The phase and deadline are critical. Note the formal instruction 'please prepare' as the opening of the body.
quests.explanation: 'Please prepare' is a formal instruction to legal advisers. Listing four specific categories - legal, financial, regulatory, operational - ensures comprehensive coverage and prevents advisers from narrowing the scope without authority.

YOURS SINCERELY,
DR HELEN MARSH, CEO
DEAR BOARD OF DIRECTORS,
SUBJECT: MERGER INTEGRATION PLAN - PROJECT FALCON POST-COMPLETION
quests.hint: The integration timeframe and four pillars are in the body. The code name continues. The board is addressed formally. Find the subject first.
quests.explanation: A one-hundred-day integration plan covering four pillars - structure, systems, clients, culture - represents the four most critical merger integration dimensions. Presenting all four simultaneously signals comprehensive planning.

quests.prompt: Write a confidential email to HR following a whistleblower disclosure.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
A WHISTLEBLOWER DISCLOSURE HAS BEEN RECEIVED UNDER OUR SPEAK-UP POLICY ALLEGING FINANCIAL IRREGULARITIES IN THE ACCOUNTS PAYABLE FUNCTION - I RECOMMEND IMMEDIATE ESCALATION TO THE AUDIT COMMITTEE.
SUBJECT: CONFIDENTIAL - WHISTLEBLOWER DISCLOSURE RECEIVED, IMMEDIATE REVIEW REQUIRED
DEAR HEAD OF HR,
quests.hint: The subject flags urgency and confidentiality. The disclosure allegation and escalation recommendation are in the body. The CCO signs by role title, not name.
quests.explanation: Recommending escalation to the Audit Committee rather than line management is the correct governance response to a financial irregularity allegation - it bypasses potentially implicated management and ensures independence.

DEAR AUDIT COMMITTEE CHAIR,

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
SUBJECT: AUDIT COMMITTEE BRIEFING - FINANCIAL MISCONDUCT INVESTIGATION STATUS
quests.hint: The investigation status and committee context are in the subject. The disclosure date, independent investigation, and briefing date are in the body. The formal closing signals official escalation.
quests.explanation: Commissioning an 'independent investigation' - rather than an internal one - is critical when management may be involved. Giving a specific briefing date ('20 November') commits the CCO to a timeline.

YOURS SINCERELY,
HEAD OF HUMAN RESOURCES
DEAR MR HAYES,
SUBJECT: FORMAL DISCIPLINARY HEARING NOTICE - 27 NOVEMBER AT 10AM
quests.hint: Date and time are in the subject. The required attendance and right to accompaniment are in the body - both are statutory. The HR head signs by role, not name.
quests.explanation: Notifying the employee of their right to accompaniment is a legal requirement in UK employment law. The hearing notice must include the date, time, and this statutory right to be legally valid.

quests.prompt: Write an email to a board nominating committee presenting a governance review report.

SUBJECT: BOARD GOVERNANCE REVIEW - FINDINGS AND RECOMMENDATIONS 2024
DEAR NOMINATIONS COMMITTEE,
quests.hint: The three governance areas requiring strengthening are in the body. The three-recommendation count previews the report. The Senior Independent Director signs - an important independent role.
quests.explanation: A governance review presented by the Senior Independent Director (SID) carries particular weight - they are the board's internal watchdog. Summarising findings as three named weaknesses upfront enables focused committee discussion.

DEAR SHAREHOLDER,

YOURS SINCERELY,
SIR JAMES HUNT, CHAIR
SUBJECT: SHAREHOLDER COMMUNICATION - ANNUAL GOVERNANCE REVIEW OUTCOMES
quests.hint: The governance outcomes and shareholder communication are in the subject. The three enhancements and accompanying document are referenced. The Chair signs - appropriate for shareholder communications.
quests.explanation: Shareholder communications on governance matters are sent by the Chair, not the CEO, to signal that the board is exercising its independent oversight function. Referring to a 'Governance Statement' provides the full detail.

SIR JAMES HUNT, CHAIR
DEAR NOMINATIONS COMMITTEE,
SUBJECT: DIRECTOR APPOINTMENT PROPOSAL - MS AMANDA WEI TO INDEPENDENT NED ROLE
quests.hint: Candidate name and role type are in the subject. The candidate's expertise and independence confirmation are in the body. The Chair proposes NED appointments to the nominations committee.
quests.explanation: Confirming that the candidate has 'completed our independence assessment' is a corporate governance requirement - it confirms there are no conflicts of interest that would compromise her independence on the board.

quests.prompt: Write a formal letter to a competitor alleging infringement of a registered design.
options:
YOURS FAITHFULLY,
GEORGIA HUNT, CHIEF LEGAL OFFICER

WE ARE IN POSSESSION OF EVIDENCE THAT YOUR PRODUCT RANGE LAUNCHED IN SEPTEMBER INFRINGES UK REGISTERED DESIGN NO. 6011228 AND WE HEREBY FORMALLY DEMAND IMMEDIATE CESSATION OF ITS MANUFACTURE AND SALE.
SUBJECT: FORMAL NOTICE OF REGISTERED DESIGN INFRINGEMENT - UK DESIGN NO. 6011228
DEAR LEGAL COUNSEL,
quests.hint: The design registration number is in both subject and body. The formal demand for cessation is in the body. 'YOURS FAITHFULLY' closes since legal counsel is addressed as a role. Find the subject first.
quests.explanation: A design infringement notice must cite the exact registration number, identify the infringing product, and make a specific demand ('immediate cessation'). 'We hereby formally demand' is the correct legal formula for such notices.

GEORGIA HUNT, CHIEF LEGAL OFFICER
SUBJECT: SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT INSTRUCTIONS - DESIGN INFRINGEMENT DISPUTE
quests.hint: The settlement purpose is in the subject. Three settlement terms - royalty rate, confidentiality, and acknowledgement - are specified. The CLO instructs internal legal as the authority.
quests.explanation: Specifying all three settlement terms - royalty rate (4.5%), confidentiality, and formal infringement acknowledgement - prevents the legal team from omitting a key element. Settlement terms must be precise to be enforceable.

YOURS SINCERELY,
GEORGIA HUNT, CLO
DEAR BOARD,
SUBJECT: IP DISPUTE RESOLVED - SETTLEMENT EXECUTED, ROYALTY INCOME FROM Q1
quests.hint: Resolution and financial outcome are in the subject. The settlement mechanism and annual income figure are in the body. The CLO signs with her abbreviated title for the board.
quests.explanation: An IP dispute resolution board report is most impactful when it converts the legal outcome into a financial benefit - '£120,000 annually from Q1' tells the board precisely what the resolution is worth commercially.

quests.prompt: Write an email to all staff announcing an updated data privacy policy.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
DATA PROTECTION OFFICER
OUR DATA PRIVACY POLICY HAS BEEN UPDATED TO REFLECT CHANGES IN THE UK GDPR FRAMEWORK - ALL STAFF ARE REQUIRED TO READ AND ACKNOWLEDGE THE REVISED POLICY VIA THE INTRANET BY 15 DECEMBER.
SUBJECT: UPDATED DATA PRIVACY POLICY - MANDATORY REVIEW BY ALL STAFF
DEAR ALL,
quests.hint: Policy update and mandatory deadline are in the subject. Regulatory basis, action required, method, and deadline are in the body. The DPO signs by role - GDPR requires this role to be identifiable.
quests.explanation: A mandatory policy review email must specify both the mechanism ('via the intranet') and the deadline ('15 December'). Citing the regulatory basis ('UK GDPR changes') explains why the update was necessary.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a third-party data processor confirming compliance with updated DPA terms.
options: OUR UPDATED DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT REFLECTS THE REVISED UK GDPR REQUIREMENTS - PLEASE CONFIRM YOUR ORGANISATION'S COMPLIANCE WITH THE NEW TERMS BY RETURNING THE SIGNED ADDENDUM BY 30 NOVEMBER.
DEAR DATA PROTECTION MANAGER,

YOURS SINCERELY,
DATA PROTECTION OFFICER
SUBJECT: DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT UPDATE - CONFIRMATION OF COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
quests.hint: Agreement type and compliance request are in the subject. Updated DPA, regulatory basis, action required, and deadline are in the body. The DPO signs by role as the regulatory-facing officer.
quests.explanation: A data processing agreement update must require a signed addendum by a specific date - oral agreement is insufficient under GDPR. The '30 November' deadline creates a clear contractual deadline for the processor to comply.

quests.prompt: Write an email to the data protection regulator notifying them of a personal data breach.
options: WE ARE NOTIFYING THE ICO OF A PERSONAL DATA BREACH DISCOVERED ON 7 NOVEMBER AFFECTING AN ESTIMATED 1,200 DATA SUBJECTS - THE BREACH HAS BEEN CONTAINED AND A FULL INCIDENT REPORT IS ATTACHED.

YOURS SINCERELY,
DATA PROTECTION OFFICER
DEAR ICO CASE OFFICER,
SUBJECT: MANDATORY BREACH NOTIFICATION - ICO REFERENCE REQUESTED
quests.hint: Mandatory notification and regulator context are in the subject. Breach date, number of subjects, containment confirmation, and attached report are in the body. All are required GDPR elements.
quests.explanation: GDPR Article 33 requires breach notifications to the ICO within 72 hours. The notification must include: discovery date, number of subjects affected, containment action taken, and the full incident report. All four appear in this email.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write a formal email to a senior executive notifying them of termination of employment.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
LADY ANNE WEST, CHAIR
I AM WRITING IN MY CAPACITY AS CHAIR OF THE BOARD TO FORMALLY NOTIFY YOU THAT YOUR EMPLOYMENT AS CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER IS TERMINATED WITH IMMEDIATE EFFECT AS OF TODAY'S DATE.
SUBJECT: TERMINATION OF EMPLOYMENT - CONFIDENTIAL AND WITHOUT PREJUDICE
DEAR MR GRAHAM,
quests.hint: The subject includes 'without prejudice' - critical legal protection. The Chair is the correct authority to terminate a C-suite appointment. The effective date is clear. Find the subject first.
quests.explanation: 'Without prejudice' protects the communication from being used in legal proceedings - essential when terminating a senior executive who may contest the decision. The Chair terminates C-suite appointments, not the CEO.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a departing executive's legal team proposing separation agreement terms.
options: WITHOUT PREJUDICE AND IN FULL AND FINAL SETTLEMENT, WE PROPOSE THE FOLLOWING TERMS: NINE MONTHS' SALARY IN LIEU OF NOTICE, A MUTUAL NON-DISPARAGEMENT CLAUSE, AND A PAYMENT OF £50,000 IN COMPENSATION.
DEAR COUNSEL,

YOURS SINCERELY,
LADY ANNE WEST, CHAIR
SUBJECT: SETTLEMENT TERMS PROPOSAL - MR GRAHAM SEPARATION
quests.hint: 'Without prejudice and in full and final settlement' are the three key legal formulas in the body. Three settlement terms follow. The Chair proposes to legal counsel rather than to the executive directly.
quests.explanation: 'Full and final settlement' means the executive cannot bring further claims. Three terms - pay in lieu, non-disparagement, and compensation - represent the standard components of a senior executive separation package.

quests.prompt: Write a formal reference email for a departing executive to a prospective employer.

YOURS SINCERELY,
LADY ANNE WEST, FORMER CHAIR
DEAR HIRING COMMITTEE,
SUBJECT: PROFESSIONAL REFERENCE - MR GRAHAM HAYES, FORMER COO
quests.hint: Reference type and candidate are in the subject. The former title, tenure dates, and substantive achievement are in the body. 'Former Chair' distinguishes the role from current capacity.
quests.explanation: A reference that cites specific tenure dates ('2019–2024') and names a concrete achievement ('transformational operational improvements') is far more credible than generic praise. 'Former Chair' identifies the authority behind the reference.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a counterparty requesting renegotiation of key contract terms.

IN LIGHT OF MATERIAL CHANGES IN MARKET CONDITIONS SINCE THE EXECUTION OF SA-2019-441, I WISH TO INVOKE OUR CONTRACTUAL RENEGOTIATION CLAUSE AND PROPOSE A MEETING TO DISCUSS REVISED COMMERCIAL TERMS.
SUBJECT: REQUEST TO RENEGOTIATE KEY TERMS - SERVICE AGREEMENT SA-2019-441
DEAR MR PATEL,
quests.hint: Contract reference and renegotiation purpose are in the subject. The material change basis and contractual clause invocation are in the body - both essential for a valid renegotiation notice.
quests.explanation: 'Material changes in market conditions' is the standard legal justification for invoking a renegotiation clause. Citing the specific clause right in the email establishes that you are acting within your contractual rights.

quests.prompt: Write an email to a contract counterparty invoking a force majeure clause.
options: I AM HEREBY NOTIFYING YOU THAT A FORCE MAJEURE EVENT, NAMELY THE GLOBAL SEMICONDUCTOR SHORTAGE, HAS RENDERED PERFORMANCE OF OUR OBLIGATIONS UNDER SA-2019-441 TEMPORARILY IMPOSSIBLE.
DEAR MR PATEL,

YOURS SINCERELY,
STEPHEN FORD, MANAGING DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: FORCE MAJEURE NOTIFICATION - CONTRACT SA-2019-441 OBLIGATIONS SUSPENDED
quests.hint: Force majeure and contract reference are in the subject. The specific qualifying event, 'hereby notifying', and the performance impact are in the body. This is a formal legal notification.
quests.explanation: 'Hereby notifying' is essential - it establishes the date of formal notification, which starts the contractual force majeure clock. Naming the specific event ('global semiconductor shortage') identifies the qualifying circumstance.

YOURS SINCERELY,
STEPHEN FORD, MANAGING DIRECTOR
DEAR MR PATEL,
SUBJECT: SIX-MONTH CONTRACT EXTENSION PROPOSAL - SA-2019-441
quests.hint: Extension duration and contract reference are in the subject. 'In lieu of renegotiation', existing terms, commencement basis, and commercial rationale are in the body.
quests.explanation: 'In lieu of renegotiation' signals this is an alternative proposal to the more contentious renegotiation. 'On existing terms' is the most commercially straightforward extension - no new negotiation needed.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to staff announcing a formal redundancy consultation process.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
CHRIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
FOLLOWING A REVIEW OF OUR OPERATIONAL STRUCTURE, THE COMPANY IS PROPOSING A REDUCTION OF TWENTY-FIVE ROLES AND IS COMMENCING A FORMAL THIRTY-DAY COLLECTIVE CONSULTATION PERIOD FROM TODAY.
SUBJECT: FORMAL REDUNDANCY CONSULTATION - WORKFORCE REDUCTION PROPOSAL
DEAR ALL,
quests.hint: The subject uses 'formal' and 'proposal' - legally significant. The number of roles, 'proposing' (not 'deciding'), and the 30-day consultation period are all legally required elements. Find the subject first.
quests.explanation: The word 'proposing' rather than 'deciding' is legally critical in redundancy - it signals the consultation is genuine and a decision has not already been made. The 30-day collective consultation period is a UK legal requirement for 20+ redundancies.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to an employee individually notifying them they are at risk of redundancy.
options: I AM WRITING TO INFORM YOU THAT YOUR ROLE OF OPERATIONS ANALYST HAS BEEN IDENTIFIED AS BEING AT RISK OF REDUNDANCY AS PART OF THE CURRENT CONSULTATION PROCESS - YOU ARE INVITED TO A CONSULTATION MEETING ON 18 NOVEMBER.
DEAR JAMES,

YOURS SINCERELY,
ANNA BLAKE, HR DIRECTOR
SUBJECT: AT RISK OF REDUNDANCY NOTIFICATION - CONFIDENTIAL - YOUR ROLE
quests.hint: 'At risk' (not 'redundant') is legally precise - it signals the process is ongoing. The role, consultation process, and meeting date are in the body. 'Confidential' in the subject protects the employee's dignity.
quests.explanation: UK law requires employees to be notified individually that their specific role is 'at risk' - not that they are redundant. The distinction matters: 'at risk' means the consultation may result in a different outcome.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER

YOURS SINCERELY,
ANNA BLAKE, HR DIRECTOR
DEAR HR COMMITTEE,
SUBJECT: REDUNDANCY SEVERANCE TERMS - COMMITTEE APPROVAL REQUESTED
quests.hint: The approval request is in the subject. Two tiers of severance - statutory minimum plus enhanced - and scope (25 roles) are in the body. The HR director seeks committee authority for the financial commitment.
quests.explanation: Presenting severance as 'statutory minimum plus enhanced pay' gives the committee a clear financial structure. Specifying the exact enhancement ('six weeks per year') means the committee can model the total liability before approving.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a regulator responding formally to a notice of regulatory sanction.
options:
YOURS SINCERELY,
CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER, NEXUS CONSULTING

WE ACKNOWLEDGE RECEIPT OF SANCTION NOTICE FCA-2024-0811 AND FORMALLY CONTEST THE BASIS OF THE SANCTION ON THE GROUNDS THAT OUR CONDUCT WAS AT ALL TIMES COMPLIANT WITH THE APPLICABLE REGULATORY FRAMEWORK.
SUBJECT: FORMAL RESPONSE TO REGULATORY SANCTION NOTICE REF: FCA-2024-0811
DEAR SUPERVISORY TEAM,
quests.hint: Sanction reference and formal response are in the subject. The notice reference, formal contest, and specific grounds for contest are in the body. The CCO is the correct officer for regulatory correspondence.
quests.explanation: 'At all times compliant with the applicable regulatory framework' is the precise legal formula for contesting a regulatory sanction - it establishes full compliance as the defence position from which any subsequent legal arguments will flow.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to senior leadership briefing them on the regulatory sanction response strategy.
options: I AM BRIEFING YOU ON OUR STRATEGY TO CONTEST THE FCA SANCTION: WE HAVE ENGAGED LINKLATERS AS EXTERNAL COUNSEL AND BELIEVE WE HAVE A STRONG CASE ON BOTH PROCEDURAL AND SUBSTANTIVE GROUNDS.
DEAR BOARD,

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
SUBJECT: REGULATORY SANCTION STRATEGY - BOARD BRIEFING AND LEGAL POSITION
quests.hint: Strategy and board audience are in the subject. External counsel name, contest basis (procedural and substantive), and confident assessment are in the body. The CCO briefs the board.
quests.explanation: Naming the external counsel ('Linklaters') signals the seriousness of the legal challenge and gives the board confidence in the quality of representation. Distinguishing 'procedural and substantive grounds' shows a two-pronged legal defence.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to a regulator submitting a compliance remediation timeline.
options: WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO OUR CONTEST, WE SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING REMEDIATION TIMELINE: PROCESS REDESIGN BY 28 FEBRUARY, STAFF RETRAINING BY 31 MARCH, AND INDEPENDENT AUDIT BY 30 APRIL.

YOURS SINCERELY,
CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER, NEXUS CONSULTING
DEAR SUPERVISORY TEAM,
SUBJECT: COMPLIANCE REMEDIATION TIMELINE - RESPONSE TO FCA-2024-0811
quests.hint: 'Without prejudice to our contest' preserves the legal position while cooperating. Three remediation steps with specific dates are in the body - required by the regulator. The sanction reference connects to the notice.
quests.explanation: 'Without prejudice to our contest' is a critical legal phrase - it means submitting the remediation plan does not constitute admission of the breach. Three dated milestones show the regulator a credible compliance path.

SUBJECT: JOINT VENTURE TERMS PROPOSAL - NEXUS CONSULTING AND KUALA LUMPUR TECH GROUP
DEAR MR WAN,

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write an email to legal counsel instructing them to review a joint venture shareholder agreement.
options: PLEASE REVIEW THE ATTACHED DRAFT SHAREHOLDER AGREEMENT FOR THE KUALA LUMPUR TECH GROUP JOINT VENTURE, WITH PARTICULAR FOCUS ON THE DEADLOCK RESOLUTION, EXIT PROVISIONS, AND GOVERNING LAW CLAUSES.
DEAR CORPORATE LAW TEAM,

YOURS SINCERELY,
GEORGIA HUNT, CLO
SUBJECT: REVIEW INSTRUCTION - JV SHAREHOLDER AGREEMENT DRAFT: KL TECH GROUP
quests.hint: Document type and JV partner are in the subject. The three specific clause areas requiring focus are in the body. The CLO instructs legal counsel on priorities.
quests.explanation: Instructing counsel to focus on 'deadlock resolution, exit provisions, and governing law' identifies the three clauses most likely to cause future disputes in a cross-border JV. Deadlock and exit clauses determine how the JV ends; governing law determines which country's courts apply.

quests.instruction: ARRANGE THE EMAIL PARTS INTO THE CORRECT ORDER
quests.prompt: Write a joint venture commencement email to the partner organisation confirming all conditions are met.
options: I AM PLEASED TO CONFIRM THAT ALL CONDITIONS PRECEDENT TO THE JOINT VENTURE HAVE BEEN SATISFIED AND THE JV FORMALLY COMMENCES ON 1 JANUARY 2025 - IT IS A PRIVILEGE TO PARTNER WITH KUALA LUMPUR TECH GROUP.

YOURS SINCERELY,
DR HELEN MARSH, CEO
DEAR MR WAN,
SUBJECT: JV COMMENCEMENT CONFIRMED - ALL CONDITIONS PRECEDENT SATISFIED
quests.hint: 'Conditions precedent satisfied' is the legal trigger for commencement. The start date and warm closing are in the body. The subject confirms the legal readiness. Find the subject line first.
quests.explanation: 'All conditions precedent satisfied' is the exact legal formula that confirms the JV can begin. Conditions precedent are the legal prerequisites agreed in the JV agreement - their satisfaction triggers formal commencement.
